python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/src/codegen/mod.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''        !module.class_methods.is_empty()
            || !module.closures.is_empty()
            || module.functions.len() > 1,'''
new = '''        // Synthetic bodies do not appear in php's trace: a program that merely NAMES
        // `RuntimeException` gets eight `_class_propinit_N` property initialisers, and counting
        // them closed the gate on every program.
        module
            .class_methods
            .iter()
            .chain(module.closures.iter())
            .chain(module.functions.iter().skip(1))
            .any(|function| !function.is_synthetic),'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new, 1))
print('synthetic bodies excluded')
